# boltons mathutils selected-module contract

Numeric utilities: clamp(x, lower=-inf, upper=inf) clips to inclusive bounds and rejects upper < lower. ceil/floor delegate to math without options; with an iterable of numeric options they return the nearest qualifying value at or above/below x independent of option order; raise ValueError if none qualifies. Bits is an immutable value/length bit sequence: nonnegative integers, binary/hex strings and bool lists; preserve explicit leading zeros, reject negative/out-of-range values, index nonnegative positions as bools, slice as Bits, compare value and length, shift/bitwise combine, convert to/from int/list/bin/hex/bytes. Hex output uses uppercase byte-width padding. See the upstream source docstrings for the full selected module contract. These specifications were written by SpecGuard from upstream documentation, not supplied by an independent product team.

Version scope: the pinned 25.0.0 implementation does not implement Python-style negative indexing. The smoke fixture uses only nonnegative indices. The exact explicit-width overflow boundary is not asserted by this small fixture; full-module mutation still includes that code.
